description: record-swap.mjs hardcodes `external: true` on EVERY recorded sol-trade line, directly contradicting REQ-002's explicit Edge Case: 'This feature makes NO claim about GATE-0 (isProfitable()/external:true) for sol-trade lines... external is never set by this wiring; scope is P&L VISIBILITY only, not a new GATE-0 classification.' It also directly contradicts the feature's OWN unit test in the same directory (record-swap.test.mjs:116-122, 'recordSwap never sets external:true (P&L VISIBILITY only -- this is not a GATE-0 classification)', which asserts `assert.notEqual(rows[0].external, true)` and `assert.equal(isProfitable(rows[0]), false, ...)`). Tracing deriveLine (skills/_shared/lib/ledger.mjs:32: `if (o.external === true) line.external = true;`) shows the persisted line's `external` field will in fact be `true`, so that specific assertion in the feature's own test file must fail when the suite is run. Consequence: isProfitable() (ledger.mjs:48-57) requires net_usdc>0 AND source not in SWAP_SOURCES AND external===true AND (sig&&confirmed); 'sol-trade' is NOT in SWAP_SOURCES (only 'swap-eth-usdc'/'swap'/'swap-usdc-eth' are), and sig+confirmed:true are always set by record-swap.mjs -- so ANY winning same-wallet Jupiter swap on Franklin's wallet will be classified `isProfitable()===true`, incorrectly granting GATE-0 ('the launch gate', per earn/run.sh's own header comment) to an internal asset-rotation event the project's own convention (ledger.mjs:36-42) says must never qualify as external revenue.

supportingEvidence.note: The feature's own test explicitly asserts external must NOT be true and isProfitable must be false -- contradicted by the shipped implementation it is testing.
deriveLine passes external through verbatim; isProfitable's classifier does not exclude source:"sol-trade" from GATE-0 eligibility.
